name: TTW World Championship
epitaph: Contested in a single-elimination tournament across four September 2002 cards, its championship was settled in a two-out-of-three-falls final.

name: TTW Impact Championship
epitaph: Announced in October 2002 to be settled by the winning team of a six-man tag qualifier, contested in a triple-threat match the promotion's own text never confirms a result for.
